# External Credentials Inventory — Infisical Rebuild Seed List

**Purpose:** when Infisical is rebuilt greenfield (ADR 0004), auto-generated secrets regenerate themselves, but **externally-issued credentials cannot be regenerated by IaC** — they come from third-party accounts. This is the checklist of what must survive, where each one comes from, and the gaps to verify before any wipe. Key names only — values live in `bootstrap.sops.yml` (SOPS) and the Infisical DR export.

**Seed mechanism:** primary = the SOPS DR export (`make infisical-backup` → `make infisical-seed`). Secondary = `bootstrap.sops.yml` `external_secrets` block, seeded during bootstrap. Anything in neither place must be re-obtained from its issuer.

## Tier-1 provider credentials (`bootstrap.sops.yml` `bootstrap` block)

| Key | Issuer / where to re-obtain | Rebuild note |
|---|---|---|
| `proxmox_password` | set by us | **changes** — new cluster root password comes from the auto-install answer files |
| `vultr_api_key` | Vultr portal → API | unchanged by migration |
| `cloudflare_api_token` | Cloudflare dashboard → API tokens | unchanged |
| `plex_username` / `plex_password` | plex.tv account | unchanged; used for claim/token retrieval |
| `infisical_*` (postgres/encryption/auth/admin/client) | generated by the bootstrap flow | regenerated on rebuild — do not carry forward |

## External secrets by Infisical folder (`external_secrets` block — present in SOPS ✓)

| Folder / key | Issuer / where to re-obtain |
|---|---|
| `infrastructure/unifi_admin_password` | set at UOS setup; survives the UniFi cloud-backup re-import |
| `infrastructure/synology_admin_password` | DSM admin account |
| `infrastructure/cloudflare_dns_api_token` | Cloudflare → scoped DNS token (DNS:edit on the service + media zones; cert-manager DNS-01 and `plex_certificate`; re-homed from `/plex` at P5b) |
| `monitoring/uptimerobot_heartbeat_url` | UptimeRobot dashboard → monitor settings |
| `monitoring/proxmox_token_value` | regenerated by `monitoring_users` against the new cluster |
| `plex_services/cloudflared_tunnel_token` | Cloudflare Zero Trust → tunnel |
| `plex_services/usenet_express_username` / `_password` | UsenetExpress account |
| `plex_services/usenet_newshosting_username` / `_password` | Newshosting account |
| `plex_services/usenet_eweka_username` / `_password` | Eweka account |
| `plex_services/usenet_frugal_username` / `_password` | Frugal Usenet account (main + bonus server share it) |
| `plex_services/nzbgeek_api_key` | NZBgeek profile |
| `plex_services/nzbplanet_api_key` | NZBplanet profile |
| `plex_services/opensubtitlescom_username` / `_password` | opensubtitles.com account |
| `pfsense/cloudflare_dns_api_token` | Cloudflare → scoped DNS token |
| `vps/maxmind_license_key` | MaxMind account → license keys |
| `homepage/portainer_api_key` | regenerate in Portainer UI post-rebuild |

## ⚠️ Gaps — external keys documented in CLAUDE.md but NOT in `bootstrap.sops.yml`

These exist only inside Infisical + the DR export. **Before any wipe (plan WP0): run a fresh `make infisical-backup` and verify each key is present in the export**, or re-obtain from the issuer:

| Folder / key | Issuer if lost |
|---|---|
| `github-runner/github_app_id`, `github_app_private_key`, `github_app_installation_id` | GitHub → App settings (private key can be regenerated, IDs are visible there) |
| `homepage/adguard_*`, `homepage/unifi_*` | service admin creds — regenerate naturally as those services rebuild |
| `homepage/authentik_token` | Authentik admin UI (service currently disabled — may be moot) |

## Maintenance

When adding a new external secret to Infisical, add it to `bootstrap.sops.yml` `external_secrets` **and** to this doc in the same change (the CLAUDE.md folder-ownership table tracks it too).
